listing.name: Luigi's Mansion — luigismansion (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Upstream reports early runtime, audio and operating-system initialization, followed by a scheduler loop polling RunQueueBits with an uninitialized interrupt-handler table. No title screen or gameplay is available. Yasiki’s completed decompilation supplies symbols; it does not make this port complete. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GameCube GLME01 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the Windows x64 source-build instructions with your own GLME01 ISO/main.dol and Yasiki symbols.csv. Generate code with gcrecomp, which must be symlinked as upstream documents, then build lm_launcher.exe with CMake and MSVC. No ready-to-use game is promised.

warnings: Upstream reports early runtime, audio and operating-system initialization, followed by a scheduler loop polling RunQueueBits with an uninitialized interrupt-handler table. No title screen or gameplay is available. Yasiki’s completed decompilation supplies symbols; it does not make this port complete.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
